title: One Point Lesson - Minimum Flow Line Operation & Deadhead Protection (OPL-GA-1201A-04)
content:
ONE POINT LESSON (OPL): OPL-GA-1201A-04 - Minimum Flow Line Operation & Deadhead Protection.

Equipment: GA-1201A (HEXANE FEED PUMP), Discipline: Process / Operations, Area: 1200 – HEXANE FEED SYSTEM.

Related Interlock: SEQ-1201 (SIL 1), P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-1201.

PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE:
Minimum flow line operation & deadhead protection for GA-1201A (HEXANE FEED PUMP) in the HEXANE FEED SYSTEM.

SAFETY PRECAUTIONS:
- Precaution 1: Obtain the correct operating permit and brief the shift team before the task.
- Precaution 2: Confirm hazardous fluids are isolated / inerted as required by procedure.
- Precaution 3: Beware of flammable, hot, or high-pressure fluids; wear the correct PPE.
- Precaution 4: Never defeat a safety interlock or trip without an authorised override permit.
- Precaution 5: Have emergency actions and communications ready before starting.

TOOLS & MATERIALS:
- Tool 1: Operating procedure & P&ID
- Tool 2: Radio / communication with panel
- Tool 3: Gas detector (O2 / LEL) as required
- Tool 4: Correct PPE for the fluid handled
- Tool 5: Sample containers & PPE for sampling
- Tool 6: Permit-to-work documentation

STEP-BY-STEP PROCEDURE:
- Step 1 – Action: Confirm FV-1201 min-flow recycle line is open before start
- Step 1 – Check: Permit valid & briefed
- Step 2 – Action: Watch that FIC-1201 stays above the 9 m³/h minimum continuous flow
- Step 2 – Check: Parameter within limit
- Step 3 – Action: If FSLL-1201 trips, check downstream XV-1201 and manual valves for a closed path
- Step 3 – Check: Interlock status confirmed
- Step 4 – Action: Do not defeat the min-flow interlock to force higher discharge pressure
- Step 4 – Check: Change logged on DCS
- Step 5 – Action: Reset the pump only after the low-flow cause has been cleared
- Step 5 – Check: Handover to next shift

COMMON PROBLEMS & TROUBLESHOOTING:
- Symptom: Hexane leak observed at GA-1201A seal gland during operation | Likely Cause: API Plan 11 flush orifice RO-1201 partially plugged causing seal face overheating | Action: Replaced mechanical seal cartridge, cleaned flush orifice
- Symptom: GA-1201A tripped on VSHH-1201 high vibration 7.4 mm/s | Likely Cause: Angular misalignment 0.12 mm/100mm after foundation settlement | Action: Laser re-aligned pump/motor, re-shimmed motor feet
- Symptom: Bearing DE noisy with rising temperature TI-1201 trend | Likely Cause: Outer race spalling on DE bearing due to prolonged misalignment | Action: Renewed DE bearing 7310 BECBM, flushed housing, refilled ISO VG 68

KEY LEARNING POINTS:
- Point 1: Never run the pump against a closed discharge. The min-flow recycle (FV-1201) protects the pump from deadhead overheating.
- Point 2: Respect the interlock SEQ-1201: PSLL-1201 trips at < 0.5 barg – never defeat it without a permit.
- Point 3: Always cross-check the Datasheet limits and P&ID TJC-LLD-PID-1201 before working on GA-1201A.
- Point 4: Record the work in the equipment history so the Knowledge Hub stays the single source of truth.
